subject: Knitting uses all variables in DF, rather than model specified variables

messages.author: 688423a3d124166c
messages.subject: Knitting uses all variables in DF, rather than model specified variables
parts: In knitting the R Notebook document, both the HTML and PDF output files include too many variables in the ggplots. For example, I only specified 4 variables in model 2; however, the plot_profiles function returned all variables in the data frame. The models and plots seem to run just fine when interactively working them in the Notebook. Am I doing something wrong?

messages.author: 688423a3d124166c
messages.subject: Re: Knitting uses all variables in DF, rather than model specified variables
parts:
Hi Josh,

Solution: If the only variables in the data frame are those that will be included in the LPA, then I do not get a warning message and the plots plot the variables in the data frame. So, if I have extra variables in the data frame that I am not including in the LPA, the ggplots return all variables in the data frame rather than only those included in the LPA.

Santi
